sanskrit_verse:
स्त्रीधनं च नरेन्द्राणां न कदाचन जीर्यते।
अनागमं भुज्यमानं वत्सराणां शतैरपि॥
transliteration: strīdhanam ca narendrāṇam na kadācana jīryate | anāgaman bhujyamānam vatsarānam śatair api ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The wealth of women and kings never decays, even when enjoyed without origin or lawful acquisition, for centuries.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in those who hold sovereignty or sacred identity.
Causation is determined by ontological status rather than procedural origin.
Capacity-based responsibility flows from existential precedence, not transactional legitimacy.
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of being over rectification of means.
Consciousness alignment supersedes forensic analysis in matters of intrinsic entitlement.
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity = sovereign OR entity = consecrated_individual THEN asset_decay_rate = 0 FOR all durations.
IF possession = untraceable_origin AND holder_status IN [sovereign, sacred] THEN title_validity = permanent.
IF duration_of_use > 100 years AND holder_type IN [king, queen, deity, renunciate] THEN evidentiary_burden = null.
IF claimant != source THEN claim_validity = false UNLESS consciousness_realignment_proven = true.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this principle establishes that the ontological class of a sovereign or sacred individual nullifies conventional doctrines of limitation or illegitimacy. Courts must recognize that the dharma-kshetra of such beings operates beyond ordinary temporal constraints, rendering moot any challenge based on procedural defect or lack of documentation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here is not empirical evidence but ontological recognition. The anupūrvaśaḥ of a king's or woman's right manifests independently of causal chain verification. Responsibility lies not in proving acquisition but in aligning with the consciousness field that sustains their entitlement. There is no punitive dimension because there is no transgression—only misrecognition of inherent sovereignty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Acknowledge the irrevocable nature of strīdhana and rajadhana through ceremonial affirmation.
Responsibility assumption protocol: Realign societal memory to reflect the timeless validity of the disputed claim.
Capacity restoration mechanism: Reinstate access to resources without conditionality tied to historical proof.
Integrity reintegration pathway: Normalize the uncontested flow of authority inherent in divine and royal lineage.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source-Authority: This law stands eternal, rooted in the immutable sovereignty of consciousness. Dharma is restored through recognition, not correction. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
